findings.article1: Amends Decree68/2026 business-individual thresholds and electronic invoicing; its Article12 references are not Decree320 Article12.
findings.article2: Adds Article4(15) to Decree320/2025: revenue-based small-enterprise exemption and related-party exclusions.
findings.article4: Transitional tax payment and non-calendar 2025 tax-period provisions.

scope_limit: Confirms this four-page instrument does not amend foreign-project credit Article12(2); does not establish exemption eligibility for every foreign project or complete review of other implementing instruments.
next_review: Circular20/2026 foreign-project filing documentation and applicable bilateral treaties.
